Lavrio B.C.|Lavrio]] | years14 = 2022 | team14 = [[Final Gençlik]] | years15 = 2022 | team15 = [[OGM Ormanspor]] | years16 = 2023 | team16 = [[Al-Arabi SC (basketball)|Al-Arabi SC]] | highlights = * [[All-NBA Development League Team|All-NBA D-League Third Team]] ([[2011–12 NBA Development League season|2012]]) * Fourth-team [[Parade All-America Boys Basketball Team|''Parade'' All-American]] (2006) }} '''Jerry Smith''' (born September 26, 1987) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Al-Arabi SC (basketball)|Al-Arabi SC]] of the [[Qatari Basketball League]]. ==High school== Jerry Smith played for [[Wauwatosa East High School]] where he holds the school's career scoring record.{{cite web|url=http://uoflsports.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/smith_jerry00.html |title=Player Bio: Jerry Smith |work=Louisville Men's Basketball |publisher=CSTV.com |access-date=2007-02-21 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070225122719/http://uoflsports.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/smith_jerry00.html |archive-date=2007-02-25 }} ==College career== He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]]. In his debut as a Cardinal, Smith broke the record for most points scored by a freshman in his first game. On February 17, 2007, Smith hit a deep, buzzer-beating 3-pointer that gave the Cardinals a 61–59 upset victory over [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]]. On February 17, 2007, Smith hit a game winning 35 footer at the buzzer. After the February 17 game, Crean gave credit to Jerry, saying that he "made a tough shot." Smith said he was speechless and that "I never dreamed about this." Prior to college, Smith played AAU basketball for DTA of Milwaukee and the Playground Warriors. He helped the first of the two to a 2nd-place finish in the national tournament. ==Professional career== Smith started playing for the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] [[NBA Summer League]] team in [[Las Vegas, Nevada|Las Vegas]]. Later he played for [[Springfield Armor]] in the [[NBA Development League]]. In March 2011 he signed with [[Waikato Pistons]] in [[New Zealand]].[https://www.cardchronicle.com/2011/3/29/2079947/jerry-smith-signs-in-new-zealand Jerry Smith signs with New Zealand team] Smith was called up by the [[New Jersey Nets]] from the Springfield Armor on March 16, 2012.[http://www.nba.com/nets/news/Jerry_Signing_Release_120316.html NETS Sign Jerry Smith to 10-Day Contract] He made his NBA debut with 5 points in 20 minutes against Orlando. He returned to the Armor on March 26, 2012.[http://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/220106/Armor-Re-Acquire-Jerry-Smith-Waive-Eugene-Spates Armor Re-Acquire Jerry Smith, Waive Eugene Spates] On July 11, 2012, Smith signed with [[Pallacanestro Cantù]].[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/98731/180 Cantu looks to future with rookie playmaker Smith] In August 2013, he signed with [[Scaligera Verona|Tezenis Verona]].{{cite web|title=Tezenis Verona tabs Jerry Smith|url=http://basketball.eurobasket.com/Italy/news/329432|publisher=Eurobasket.com|accessdate=19 August 2013}} In August 2014, he signed with [[Maccabi Rishon LeZion (basketball)|Maccabi Rishon LeZion]] of Israel.[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/israel/130841/jerry-smith-signs-with-maccabi-rishon-lezion.html Jerry Smith signs with Maccabi Rishon LeZion] On February 8, 2015, he left Maccabi and signed with [[Eisbären Bremerhaven]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/germany/151663/eisbaren-bremerhaven-land-jerry-smith.html Eisbaren-Bremerhaven land Jerry Smith] On June 7, 2015, he re-signed with Eisbären Bremerhaven for one more season.[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/germany/163204/jerry-smith-signs-a-contract-extension-with-eisbaren-bremerhaven.html Jerry Smith signs a contract extension with Eisbaren-Bremerhaven] On August 6, 2018, he joined [[Ifaistos Limnou B.C.|Ifaistos Limnou]] of the [[Greek Basket League]].[https://www.a1basket.gr/2018/08/ifaistos-limnou-signed-jerry-smith.html Ifaistos Limnou signed Jerry Smith] On August 7, 2019, Smith renewed his contract with the Greek club for another season. On August 19, 2020, Smith moved to fellow [[Greek Basket League]] club [[Larisa B.C.|Larisa]].{{cite web |title=Larisa announces Jerry Smith |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/jerry-smith-inks-with-larisa/ |website=Sportando |accessdate=August 19, 2020 |date=August 19, 2020}} On August 3, 2021, Smith signed with [[Greek Basket League]] finalists [[G.S. Lavrio B.C.|Lavrio]].{{cite web |title=Lavrio lands Jerry Smith |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/lavrio-lands-jerry-smith/ |website=Sportando |access-date=August 4, 2021 |date=August 3, 2021}} He averaged 8.4 points, 1.6 rebounds, and 1.2 assists per game. On March 1, 2022, Smith signed with [[Final Gençlik]] of the [[Turkish Basketball First League]].{{cite web |last1=Yahyabeyoglu |first1=Fersu |title=Final Spor sign a second USA player, ex Lavrio |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Turkey/news/733564/Final-Spor-sign-a-second-USA-player,-ex-Lavrio |website=Eurobasket |access-date=March 1, 2022 |date=March 1, 2022}} He subsequently joined [[OGM Ormanspor]] but left the team in November 2022 after three games. On March 4, 2023, Smith signed with [[Al-Arabi SC (basketball)|Al-Arabi SC]] of the [[Qatari Basketball League]].{{cite web |last1=Obradovic |first1=Igor |title=Jerry Smith (ex OGM Orman) is a newcomer at Al Arabi |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Turkey/news/796615/Jerry-Smith-(ex-OGM-Orman)-is-a-newcomer-at-Al-Arabi |website=Eurobasket |access-date=March 5, 2023 |date=March 4, 2023}} === The Basketball Tournament (TBT) (2017–present) === In the summer of 2017, Smith played in [[The Basketball Tournament]] on [[ESPN]] for Team Challenge ALS. He competed for the $2 million prize in 2017, and for Team Challenge ALS, he averaged 9.2 points per game, also shooting 83 percent from the free-throw line. Smith helped take the sixth-seeded Team Challenge ALS to the Championship Game of the tournament, where they lost in a close game to Overseas Elite 86–83.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thetournament.com/bracket|title=Bracket {{!}} The Basketball Tournament|website=www.thetournament.com|language=en|access-date=2018-02-27|archive-date=2019-05-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190514091135/https://www.thetournament.com/bracket|url-status=dead}} In TBT 2018, Smith averaged 2.8 points per game and one steal per game for Team Challenge ALS. They reached the West Regional Championship Game before losing to eventual tournament runner-up Eberlein Drive. ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== {{NBA player statistics
